pages.text: With $(l)Villager Recruits: Village Expansion$() installed, its villages are the NPC kingdoms. You can open each one like a city, but Living Realms never runs or rebuilds them. Your kingdom joins its diplomacy as a $(l)realm$(), a Recruits faction you lead.

$(l)Military → Realms$() lists the factions within raid range: at war, neutral or allied, with their villages and soldiers.$(br2)Nearby factions may $(l)declare war$() on you, and their villages then march on your cities. $(l)Declare war$() yourself to raid theirs. $(l)Make peace$() needs their consent and brings a one-day truce.

Raids work as usual: defeat the garrison and hold the centre for 60 seconds. A village you take becomes your city, claim and all; take their $(l)capital$() and every village of the faction joins you.$(br2)Lose your capital and all your cities become theirs. Recruits sieges of claimed villages count too.

$(l)Auto build$() follows Village Expansion's city planner: its streets from the centre and its lots. Villagers pick a lot in the right district (noisy trades and fields away from the centre), turn the building's door to the street and lay the street in front.$(br2)Your own plans still come first.
